title: rl_finance run record
description: One (task, attempt) of any run, API or Harbor. Records are comparable only when task_id, content_sha256 and fingerprint match and the condition (mode, runner, model, skills, effort, max_tokens, judge_model) is the same; rl/harness/report.py enforces it.

mode.description: the task's mode (review, compare, produce); rewards of different modes are never one number

split.description: train, bench, heldout, eval or retired; null if the task is not in its manifest

content_sha256.description: the task's content hash (FORMAT.md, Integrity); null when the run predates task bundles

fingerprint.description: hash of exactly what the model sees; null when not recorded

attempt.description: 0-based repetition of the task under the same condition

runner.description: what produced the result: name (script or harbor), agent, version, variant

model.description: requested model; null for solvers and the oracle

skills.description: skills condition: enabled, profile, source_commit, entries

judge_model.description: the grader's model (LLM judge or scorer), if any

rewards.description: named metrics as the verifier reports them; never blended

usage.description: input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, summed over the attempt

cost_usd.description: model cost from rl/harness/prices.yaml; null when the price or usage is unknown

trace.description: path to the transcript or Harbor trial directory
